title: The Weeping Statue
text: A saint in grey stone, her face worn smooth by centuries of hands, weeps clear water into a bowl at her feet. The bowl never fills, and the water never stops. Dead flowers from pilgrims long gone lie heaped around her.

options.label: The healer drinks the saint's tears, taking her grief inside them.

outcomes.text: The water stays cold inside them, like a well.
They sleep badly ever after, and will not say what the saint shows them.

options.label: Leave her to her grief; some sorrows are not yours to share.

outcomes.text: Her weeping follows you a long way.
